headline: French Sovereign Borrowing Costs Surpass US Yields Amid Domestic Budget Turmoil
summary: French government bond yields climbed above comparable US Treasury rates following persistent selling triggered by domestic fiscal strain and ongoing political unrest.
why: France is the second-largest economy in the eurozone, and surging borrowing costs elevate sovereign debt servicing burdens and systemic risk.

impacts.name: France
impacts.why: Higher sovereign yields raise government borrowing costs and increase fiscal pressure amid budget disputes.

why_moved: French bond prices fell, driving yields above US levels, as investors demanded a higher risk premium amid fiscal discord.
